admin_confirm_list_description: Sensitive actions requested by AI over MCP run only after an admin confirms them
admin_confirm_table_label: Actions requested by AI awaiting confirmation
admin_confirm_empty_body: When AI calls a sensitive tool, the request shows up here with a confirmation link.
admin_confirm_not_found_body: The link may be wrong, or the record was cleaned up.
admin_confirm_title_revoke: Revoke a credit batch from workspace {workspace}
admin_confirm_not_owner: This was requested with another admin's token ({email}). Only they can confirm it; you can reject it.
admin_confirm_not_owner_unknown: This was requested with another admin's token. Only they can confirm it; you can reject it.
admin_confirm_footnote: Confirming asks you to re-verify, and runs exactly what the table shows. It won't run if the target changed in the meantime, or the requesting token was revoked or expired.
admin_confirm_banner_done_refund: Done: the refund decision was submitted. Check the Refunds page for the payment platform's result.
admin_confirm_banner_follow_up: Done, but a follow-up step failed ({code}). Check the related page.
admin_confirm_banner_revoked: Not run: the requesting token was revoked or expired, or its admin is no longer active.
admin_confirm_banner_stale: Not run: the target changed after the request and no longer matches what was shown. Ask the AI to request it again.
admin_confirm_banner_secret: Not run: the secret value can no longer be decrypted (it may have expired). Ask the AI to request it again.
admin_confirm_banner_expired: Expired (not confirmed within 30 minutes). It won't run.
admin_confirm_error_not_owner: Only the admin who owns the requesting token can confirm this.
admin_confirm_error_not_pending: This request was already handled or expired. The page has been refreshed.
admin_confirm_error_failed: The action didn't complete. Refresh the page to see the current state.
